The best affiliate networks are  [Highlight start] **impact.com, Awin, CJ Affiliate, PartnerStack, and Amazon Associates** [Highlight end] , depending on whether you are a publisher/creator looking for high-converting offers or a brand building a partner program.[[1]](https://mthink.com/all-networks/best-cps-affiliate-networks/)[[2]](https://www.hamstergarage.com/article/best-affiliate-networks-for-brands-guide)[[3]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iTzr2GvynRo&t=294)[[4]](https://shoutmeloud.com/top-affiliate-networks.html)

If you are starting out as a creator or publisher, **impact.com** is the strongest overall choice due to its modern tracking, direct access to major enterprise brands, and fast payouts.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N7nyWQc6E1c&t=326)[[2]](https://mthink.com/all-networks/best-cps-affiliate-networks/)[[3]](https://impact.com/affiliate-marketing/)

#### Top Affiliate Networks Compared

| Network | Best For | Key Strengths | Notable Considerations |
|---|---|---|---|
| **[impact.com](https://impact.com/affiliate-marketing/)** | Overall & Major Brands | Modern interface, cross-device tracking, and access to 250k+ publishers and major enterprise brands. | Individual brand approvals can be selective for brand-new websites. |
| **[Awin](https://www.awin.com/)** | Retail & E-commerce | Massive global reach with over 30,000 advertisers (now incorporating former ShareASale merchants). | Requires a small refundable verification deposit for new publishers. |
| **[CJ Affiliate](https://www.cj.com/)** | Established Publishers | High-paying Fortune 500 brands across retail, travel, and finance. | Clunkier interface; accounts can be deactivated if no sales occur within 6 months. |
| **[PartnerStack](https://partnerstack.com/)** | B2B & SaaS | Single dashboard for high-ticket recurring software commissions (e.g., Notion, Thinkific). | Focused strictly on software/B2B; high platform fees for merchants. |
| **[Amazon Associates](https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/)** | Beginners & High Volume | Easiest approval process, unmatched buyer trust, and commissions on entire shopping carts. | Low commission rates (1–10%) and a short 24-hour cookie window. |

#### Best Picks by Niche & Model

- **Digital Products & High Commissions.** [ClickBank](https://www.clickbank.com/) and [Digistore24](https://www.digistore24.com/) specialize in digital courses, software, and supplements, frequently offering 50% to 75%+ commissions with instant approval for beginners.[[1]](https://progriso.com/best-affiliate-marketing-programs-for-beginners/)[[2]](https://www.sorank.com/blog-geo-seo/best-affiliate-networks)
- **Travel.** [Travelpayouts](https://www.travelpayouts.com/) aggregates dozens of flight, hotel, and car rental programs into one dashboard, while [Rakuten Advertising](https://rakutenadvertising.com/) partners with major luxury and global travel brands.[[1]](https://mthink.com/all-networks/best-cps-affiliate-networks/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N7nyWQc6E1c&t=326)
- **Content Monetization & Automation.** [Skimlinks](https://skimlinks.com/) automatically converts standard product links in your editorial content into affiliate links across tens of thousands of merchants without requiring individual program applications.[[1]](https://mthink.com/all-networks/best-cps-affiliate-networks/)
- **CPA (Cost-Per-Action) & Lead Gen.** Networks like [Perform[cb]](https://performcb.com/) and [CrakRevenue](https://www.crakrevenue.com/) pay for specific user actions (app installs, sign-ups, or leads) rather than requiring a completed purchase.[[1]](https://www.businessofapps.com/affiliate/networks/)

#### Choosing the Right Platform

- **For Publishers & Creators:** Most successful affiliates join two to three networks rather than relying on one. Start with **Amazon Associates** to monetize everyday product mentions immediately, then apply to **impact.com** or **Awin** for higher commission rates and longer 30-day cookie windows.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b7NObumGRmc)[[2]](https://wecantrack.com/insights/biggest-affiliate-network/)[[3]](https://mthink.com/all-networks/best-cps-affiliate-networks/)[[4]](https://progriso.com/best-affiliate-marketing-programs-for-beginners/)
- **For Brands & Merchants:** Look closely at fee structures and fraud protection. **Awin** and **impact.com** offer robust recruitment marketplaces and automated compliance tools, while lighter software like [Rewardful](https://www.rewardful.com/) or [FirstPromoter](https://firstpromoter.com/) helps early-stage SaaS companies avoid heavy network overhead.[[1]](https://www.hamstergarage.com/article/best-affiliate-networks-for-brands-guide)[[2]](https://impact.com/affiliate-marketing/)

To narrow down the best options for you, could you share:

- Your **role** (publisher/creator looking to earn commissions, or a brand launching a program)
- Your primary **niche or industry** (e.g., tech/SaaS, fashion, finance, travel)
- Your **traffic source** (blog/SEO, YouTube, TikTok/Instagram, paid ads, or email)
